_source: GET /api/v1/projects/engagement-portal/environments, handlers/projects.go:2116-2152: one row map per environment (name, branch, displayName, primary, subdomain, status, lastDeploy), replicas added ONLY when the namespace was read (:2138-2140), wrapped in models.ListResponse (:2152). production is the base row (primary, its real branch main); feat-evidence-upload is a non-base row whose branch LABEL equals its env key (Env == Branch, :2109-2111), never feat/evidence-upload, and whose namespace was not read (no batch entry, :2056-2067), so no replicas key and the default status and lastDeploy
